sources.title: Reactive Diffusion Policy
sources.snippet: Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP) is a slow-fast imitation learning algorithm that can model complex behaviors with a slow policy network and achieve closed-loop control based on tactile / force feedback with a fast policy network.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Models for Automated Bone Age ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: Traditional methods—Greulich-Pyle atlas and Tanner-Whitehouse scoring—are time-consuming, operator-dependent, and prone to inter- and intra-observer variability. Aim: To systematically review the performance of AI-based models for automated bone-age estimation from left PA hand-wrist radiographs.
